page_title: CLE 0-3 TOU | Clermont v Toulouse 31/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' A player from Clermont commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
90+2' It's time for a substitution. Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) comes on in place of Alan Virginius.

90+2' What a wasted opportunity by Shavy Babicka (Toulouse)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Massamba N'Diaye makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
90+1' A pass from Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) is intercepted by Massamba N'Diaye and the move breaks down.
90+1' We will have 3 min. of added time.

90' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Habib Keita (Clermont) after he collected a pass and unleashed a shot. The ball was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper made an easy save.

89' Yoel Armougom (Clermont) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the right post is, however, superbly saved by Guillaume Restes!
87' Substitution. Thijs Dallinga did his best and is replaced by Shavy Babicka (Toulouse).

87' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot just over the bar. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better! The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.
85' Yoel Armougom (Clermont) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
84' Clermont are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) is coming onto the pitch as Yann Gboho cannot continue after picking up an injury.

81' OFF THE WOODWORK! Alan Virginius (Clermont) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot that smashes against the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
79' 0 - 3 Goal - 0:3! Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) receives a precise pass inside the box from Yann Gboho and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
78' Ivan M'Bahia (Clermont) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
77' Substitution. Maximiliano Caufriez makes way for Jeremie Bela (Clermont).
77' Pascal Gastien decides to make a substitution. Mehdi Zeffane will be replaced by Ivan M'Bahia (Clermont).

77' What a big chance! Alan Virginius (Clermont) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
76' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
74' The game has come to an end for Frank Magri. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse).
73' 0 - 2 Goal Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse)! Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) was put through by Frank Magri and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
72' Alan Virginius (Clermont) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

72' A neat pass is well received by Alan Virginius (Clermont), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot. The ball is out of play. Clermont win a corner kick.
70' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
69' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) swings in a cross from the corner, but Massamba N'Diaye reads it well and gathers the ball.
69' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Clermont, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
66' Moussa Diarra (Toulouse) commits a foul during an attacking move.
63' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Clermont.
62' Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) trips an opposition player and Pierre Gaillouste signals a foul.
61' The substitution is prepared. Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Bilal Boutobba.
61' Pascal Gastien has decided to make a change. Habib Keita (Clermont) replaces Jim Allevinah.
61' Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
60' Jim Allevinah (Clermont) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
59' A player from Toulouse commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
58' The resulting corner from Alan Virginius (Clermont) is cleared.
54' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) takes the corner which is cleared.
54' Frank Magri (Toulouse) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. Toulouse win a corner.
53' Frank Magri (Toulouse) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.
49' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
47' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Clermont.
47' Toulouse seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
46' We are about to witness a subsitution. Moussa Diarra (Toulouse) for Mikkel Desler.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+7' Pierre Gaillouste has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Yoel Armougom (Clermont) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
45+4' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
45+2' The corner from Alan Virginius (Clermont) is intercepted by Guillaume Restes.

45+1' Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) receives a pass, beats an opponent and tries a long-range shot. It's a weak effort towards the top left corner and Guillaume Restes easily plucks the ball out of the air. The linesman makes the right call and Clermont will have a corner.
45+1' The corner from Alan Virginius (Clermont) is hurriedly cleared.
45+1' Alan Virginius (Clermont) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away. Clermont force their opponents to concede a corner.
45+1' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
44' A pass from Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) is intercepted by Guillaume Restes and the move breaks down.
42' Andy Pelmard (Clermont) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
42' Frank Magri (Toulouse) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
39' Jim Allevinah (Clermont) takes the corner but it's cleared.
38' Mikkel Desler (Toulouse) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
34' Alan Virginius (Clermont) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
32' Alan Virginius (Clermont) sends the corner into the box, but Guillaume Restes intercepts it and averts the threat.
32' Yoel Armougom (Clermont) collects a pass and has an effort from distance which is blocked. Good work from Clermont as they win a corner.
29' A player from Clermont commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
29' The ball is out of play. Toulouse will have a throw-in.

26' Logan Costa (Toulouse) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.

25' Toulouse slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
24' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
21' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. It's a throw-in for Clermont.
18' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
14' Wonderful movement by Clermont. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
11' The corner is swung in but Clermont can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
10' None of the Clermont players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
9' The ball goes out for a corner. Clermont can continue in their attacking effort. Clermont have been awarded a corner kick.
8' 0 - 1 Goal! Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Massamba N'Diaye to commit before slotting the penalty into the right of the goal.
8' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
6' Maximiliano Caufriez (Clermont) picks up a yellow card.
6' Referee Pierre Gaillouste sees the trip by Maximiliano Caufriez (Clermont) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. The referee makes the call - penalty to Toulouse!
2' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Toulouse.
1' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop his effort.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Toulouse will take the kick-off.
Pierre Gaillouste was nominated as the referee for this game.
